what_works: Matte-black + warm-neutral palette with subtle gold accents — luxury achieved by omission. Architectural details (granite, timber, steel) photographed at close range as compositional anchors rather than just material shots.
what_does_not_translate: Clearcut e-commerce product photography on white is a specialty-coffee-brand standard; for trades, transfer the matte-black-plus-warm-neutral palette and the material close-up photography style.
type_observations: Contemporary editorial sans with generous spacing; copy stays evocatively brief ('Warm, comforting and familiar'). Restraint defines the type system.
